New Product · June 2026
The complete store,
on one screen.
AgroStar POS is built from the ground up to run our Company Owned stores — connecting orders, inventory, and finance into a single mobile-first experience. When a store opens, POS opens. That's it.
TL;DR — 30 seconds
→  We built AgroStar POS — a purpose-built mobile app to run our 7 Company Owned stores end-to-end.
→  One screen replaces three enterprise systems: order management, warehouse, and finance — all talking in real time.
→  Live since May 15. 65 orders. 57 farmers served. ₹73,824 in sales. Growing every week.

Magic Moment 01
The stock arrives.
The store is ready in minutes.
A truck pulls up. The store manager opens POS on their phone. They tap through incoming inventory — batch by batch, good or damaged — and hit confirm. The warehouse system updates automatically. No calls. No email. No waiting.
📦  Raise stock requests — auto-converts to a warehouse transfer order
✅  Receive incoming stock with good/bad capture per batch — warehouse updates instantly
🔄  Mark damaged inventory — moves to the correct bin in the warehouse automatically
Magic Moment 02
A farmer walks in.
Billed and out in under 3 minutes.
The manager searches the farmer by mobile. Profile appears instantly. The farmer browses live prices, active offers, real stock. They pick what they need. The system selects the right batch automatically. Invoice generated. Payment collected — cash or a QR code on screen. The ledger reconciles itself.
🔍  Search any farmer by mobile — or register a new one instantly
🛒  Full catalog with live prices, offers, stock count — same data as the farmer app
🧾  Invoice pushed to the financial system automatically — zero manual entry
💳  Cash (to store VAN) or dynamic UPI QR — both reconcile to the ledger automatically
↩️  Returns on the same screen — condition captured, credit posted automatically
Magic Moment 03
An online order just came in.
The store handles it.
A farmer in the store's catchment placed an order on the AgroStar app. It routes directly to the nearest COCO store. The manager sees it in POS, marks it available and triggers the invoice in one tap. Returns handled on the same screen — logged, inventory updated, credit posted.
📲  DVS orders routed to the store appear directly in POS — accept, flag OOS, or process
🚚  Invoice sent to warehouse and logistics automatically at dispatch
🔁  Out-of-stock items trigger auto-restock — same engine as the Saathi partner network
Under the Hood
POS is not a billing app. It is the connective layer between three systems that had never spoken to each other in a retail context. When a sale happens on POS, all three know about it instantly and automatically.
